name: MAK
notes: Two sources combined: (1) POST to the jart calendar endpoint (events-limit=300) returns all ~106 dated occurrences (guided tours, talks, workshops) as ld+json Event blocks with clean ISO startDate; (2) the /programm/ausstellungen index + each exhibition detail page gives ~10 long-running exhibitions as single far-end records. No price info anywhere on site, price_min/price_text always null. Two exhibitions (Visual Investigations, Women of the Wiener Werkstätte) run at satellite venues outside Vienna (LA, NYC) so venue/district/city/address are null for those by design.
